questions.q: What is a "data region" in Report Builder?
options: Any report item bound to a dataset that repeats its layout once per row or group of data
A physical section of the printed page, unrelated to data
Another name for a data source
A term used only for charts, never tables
questions.explain: Tables, matrices, lists, and charts are all data regions — items bound to a dataset that repeat their layout according to the data.

questions.q: In the Table or Matrix Wizard's Arrange fields page, what do the fields you drag into Row groups control?
options: A new row grouping is created each time the value of that field changes, and the order of fields defines the group hierarchy
They control the report's page size
They determine which data source is used
Row groups only affect column width
questions.explain: Fields in Row groups define the grouping hierarchy — for example, SalesDate then Subcategory nests Subcategory inside each SalesDate group.

questions.q: What's the key structural difference between a Table and a List data region?
options: A Table lays data out as a fixed grid of rows and columns; a List repeats an entire freeform block layout once per record
A List can only ever contain images
A Table cannot use groups; only a List can
There is no structural difference — they render identically
questions.explain: Table is best for spreadsheet-style tabular data; List is best for card- or form-style repeats, like a directory of employee cards.

questions.q: What does bracketed text like [Sum(Sales)] mean when you see it in a table on the design surface?
options: It's a placeholder showing the field binding — the real aggregated value only appears when you Run the report
It means the report has a syntax error
It's literal text that will print exactly as shown
It means the field is unbound and won't work
questions.explain: Design view shows placeholders like [Sum(Sales)] to represent field bindings; actual data only resolves when you preview the report with Run.

questions.q: After finishing the Table or Matrix Wizard, where can you confirm the row groups it created?
options: The Row Groups pane at the bottom of the design surface
Only by re-running the wizard from scratch
The Report Data pane's Parameters folder
Row groups aren't visible anywhere after the wizard finishes
questions.explain: The Row Groups pane shows the nested groups the wizard created, matching exactly what was dragged into the Row groups box.
